Social Responsibility Audit Report
Supplier: Vietnam Footwear Assembly JSC
Factory: Ho Chi Minh City Footwear Plant
Audit Date: January 15-17, 2026
Audit Standard: RBA Code of Conduct v8.0
Lead Auditor: Sarah Nguyen

Executive Summary:
Facility produces athletic footwear with 2,150 employees. Audit identified systemic issues with working hours, emergency preparedness, and wage transparency.

Overall Score: 47% (Minor Non-conformances: 22, Major Non-conformances: 7, Critical: 3)

Section 3: Health and Safety

3.1 Emergency Preparedness
No evacuation drill conducted in 2025. Fire extinguishers on Production Floor B last inspected April 2024.

3.2 Safety Training
New hire safety training limited to 2-hour orientation. No refresher training program. Machine safety training documented for only 60% of operators.

3.3 PPE
Cut-resistant gloves provided but workers report discomfort and remove them during operations. Safety footwear compliance 70%.

3.4 Chemical Safety
Adhesive and solvent use in assembly area lacks adequate local exhaust ventilation. Workers reported headaches and dizziness. SDS available for 80% of chemicals used.

text:
Section 3: Health and Safety (continued)

3.5 Emergency Exits
All emergency exits on Production Floor A unobstructed. Production Floor B: Exit B-2 blocked by raw material staging area. Exit B-3 door handle broken, requires two hands to open.

Building C (warehouse): Emergency exit signage missing on 2nd and 3rd floors. Exit path on 3rd floor cluttered with returned goods.

Fire alarm system: Manual pull stations present but automatic detection system not connected to central alarm on Floors 2-4.

text:
Section 4: Labor

4.1 Working Hours
December 2025 peak season records: 156 workers exceeded 60 hours/week for 4 consecutive weeks. 23 workers exceeded 72 hours/week. Night shift operates 7pm-7am with mandatory overtime on Saturdays.

4.2 Wages and Benefits
Base wage meets minimum. However: (a) attendance bonus structure unclear, (b) piece-rate calculations not transparent, (c) night shift differential not documented.

4.3 Workers' Rights
Union exists but independent worker interviews suggest management influence. Two workers reported fear of retaliation for raising safety concerns.

4.4 Recruitment
Labor broker fees deducted from first 3 months' wages for 87 migrant workers from rural provinces.

text:
Section 5: Environment

5.1 Environmental Permits
Current and valid. Air quality monitoring conducted monthly.

5.2 Hazardous Waste
Waste adhesive and solvent containers stored beyond 90-day limit. Three 55-gallon drums present since August 2025.

5.3 Air Emissions
VOC levels in assembly area exceed occupational exposure limits. Industrial hygiene assessment not conducted.

5.4 Energy
Energy consumption data shows 23% increase year-over-year with no efficiency program in place.

text:
Section 6: Ethics

6.1 Business Integrity
Gift and entertainment policy exists but not enforced consistently. Three instances of vendor gifts exceeding $100 threshold without disclosure.

6.2 Privacy
Worker biometric data (fingerprint attendance) collected without written consent. Data shared with labor broker for payroll processing.

6.3 Grievance Mechanisms
Suggestion boxes present but no evidence of response process. Worker hotline in Vietnamese only, excludes Khmer-speaking seasonal workers.

Section 7: Management System

7.1 No systematic management system. Corrective actions from previous audit (2023) not tracked. Quality management limited to product quality, not social compliance.
